\[
S = 1.4826\,\operatorname{median}_{w \in W} |w - m|,
\qquad
I_{\text{out}} =
\begin{cases}
m & |I - m| > t\,S \\
I & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases},
\qquad t = 3
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(m\): The median of the window
- \(S\): The scaled median absolute deviation
- \(t\): The threshold in units of S

m is the median of the window W, and the MAD is the median of the distances from m. The factor 1.4826, which is 1 divided by the 75th percentile of the standard normal distribution, makes S estimate the standard deviation of Gaussian noise. A value further than t S from the median is an outlier. In a perfectly flat window S is 0, so any different value counts.
